title: Deep Freeze an Object for Immutability
description: Implement a deepFreeze function that recursively freezes an object and all nested properties.
solutionBody:
### Approach

1. Iterate over the object's entries using `Object.entries(myObject)`.
2. If a value is of type `'object'` and not null, recursively call `deepFreeze` on it.
3. Return `Object.freeze(myObject)` after all nested properties are frozen.

title: Implement Array.prototype.myMap
description: Write a polyfill for Array.prototype.map that reproduces native behavior.
questionBody:
### Problem Statement

Implement `Array.prototype.myMap(callback, thisArg)` to mirror the behavior of the built-in `Array.prototype.map`.
solutionBody:
### Approach

1. Throw a `TypeError` if callback is not callable.
2. Allocate a new result array of equal length.
3. Iterate over sparse indices using `in` check, invoking callback with `(element, index, array)` and optional `thisArg`.
